title: Text-Based Adventure Game
objective: Build a command-driven adventure with rooms, inventory, branching choices, state validation, and save/load.

milestones.title: World Model
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate world model in the project with a focused, reproducible example.
Provide a test or manual verification record.

milestones.title: Commands
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate commands in the project with a focused, reproducible example.
Provide a test or manual verification record.

milestones.title: Inventory
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate inventory in the project with a focused, reproducible example.
Provide a test or manual verification record.

milestones.title: State Transitions
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate state transitions in the project with a focused, reproducible example.
Provide a test or manual verification record.

milestones.title: Save/Load
acceptance_criteria: Demonstrate save/load in the project with a focused, reproducible example.
Provide a test or manual verification record.

starter_files.purpose: Document setup, runtime requirements, design and test steps.
Main entry point or application composition.
Document automated/manual tests and expected results.

required_features: Implement world model for the stated scenario.
Implement commands for the stated scenario.
Implement inventory for the stated scenario.
Implement state transitions for the stated scenario.
Document setup and a repeatable way to verify the expected behavior.
stretch_features: Add additional edge cases or property-style tests.
Compare a simpler alternative and explain trade-offs.
Add version-specific compatibility checks if relevant.

tests.name: primary behavior
tests.expected: The core scenario matches its acceptance criteria.

tests.name: boundary behavior
tests.expected: Invalid, missing or boundary inputs are handled deliberately.

tests.name: clean setup
tests.expected: A reviewer can reproduce setup and run the project from the documented instructions.

rubric.description: Required user-visible behavior works for documented cases.
Boundary conditions, invalid data, and error outcomes are handled intentionally.
Clear modules, cohesive functions, useful names, and limited side effects.
Repeatable checks, setup steps, and expected results are documented.
Assumptions, runtime/version requirements, and known limitations are stated.

review_method: Automated checks where available plus human review for design quality, runtime assumptions, security, documentation, and project-specific behavior.
status_note: Project brief and solution outline require technical review; no claim is made that a full implementation or host-specific runtime was executed.
